definitions.explanation: The visual rear portion of a picture, photograph, or scene — what lies behind the main subject.
The circumstances, history, or context underlying an event, decision, or person. Often used to explain why something happened.

examples.japanese: {背景|はいけい}に{富士山|ふじさん}が{写|うつ}っている。
examples.english: Mt. Fuji is in the background of the photo.

examples.japanese: {背景|はいけい}を{白|しろ}に{設定|せってい}してください。
examples.english: Please set the background to white.

examples.japanese: {舞台|ぶたい}の{背景|はいけい}がとても{美|うつく}しかった。
examples.english: The backdrop of the stage was very beautiful.

examples.japanese: {事件|じけん}の{背景|はいけい}を{調|しら}べる。
examples.english: To investigate the background of the incident.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{成功|せいこう}には{家族|かぞく}の{支|ささ}えという{背景|はいけい}がある。
examples.english: Behind his success lies the support of his family.

examples.japanese: この{政策|せいさく}が{導入|どうにゅう}された{背景|はいけい}には、{長年|ながねん}の{議論|ぎろん}があった。
examples.english: Behind the introduction of this policy were many years of debate.

notes:
Composed of {背|はい} (back) + {景|けい} (scene). Covers both literal visual backgrounds and figurative contextual backgrounds. The figurative sense is very common in journalism and analysis.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {背景|はいけい}{画像|がぞう}: background image
- {背景|はいけい}{色|いろ}: background color
- {背景|はいけい}{音楽|おんがく}: background music (often abbreviated BGM)
- {背景|はいけい}を{調|しら}べる: to investigate the background
- {背景|はいけい}には〜がある: behind ~ lies
- {社会|しゃかい}{的|てき}{背景|はいけい}: social background; social context
- {家庭|かてい}{背景|はいけい}: family background

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {背後|はいご}: behind; rear — physical position, or a hidden actor pulling strings
- {裏|うら}: behind the scenes; reverse side — emphasizes what is hidden
- {状況|じょうきょう}: situation — the current state, not the prior context
